results.description: Monthly income/spending match canonical recompute (signed_amount + transfer_tag IS NULL + exclusions)
results.query_or_script:
# Hand-roll SQL using canonical pattern for current and prior months
income_excl_ph, income_excl = get_income_exclusion_clause()
excl_ph, excl = get_spend_exclusion_clause()
acct_sql, acct_params = build_account_filter(conn, None, None)  # household
_EM = "COALESCE(effective_month, strftime('%Y-%m', posting_date))"

months_to_check = [(2026,2), (2026,3), (2026,4)]
mismatches = []
for (y, m) in months_to_check:
    em = f"{y}-{m:02d}"
    row = conn.execute(f'''
        SELECT
            SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_tag IS NULL AND signed_amount > 0
                          AND COALESCE(category, 'Other Income') NOT IN ({income_excl_ph})
                     THEN signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_tag IS NULL AND signed_amount < 0
                          AND COALESCE(category, 'Uncategorized') NOT IN ({excl_ph})
                     THEN -signed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS spending
        FROM transactions
        WHERE status='posted' AND posting_date IS NOT NULL
          AND {_EM} = ?
          ''' + acct_sql,
        income_excl + excl + [em] + acct_params).fetchone()
